App to use for self-service purposes together with ticketshop.lv ticket sales platform.

After choosing any of your active events, there is ticket scanner and dashboard functionality available.

With ticket scanner you can:
- scan printed tickets, both .pdf print-outs and thermal prints
- scan tickets from any device screen
- get immediate info if the ticket is valid/fake/duplicate
- get immediate info if there are any specific conditions for the ticket
- see detailed information about the scanned ticket
- input ticket code manually if needed

One the dashboard you can see:
- total tickets scanned count out of all eligible tickets
- scanned ticket count breakdown by type - platform sold, promoter sold, invitations
- log of all scanned tickets with ability to see details for each scan

App works in on-line mode. It is accessible using the credentials from ticketshop.lv promoters account.
